items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And you got a name? Marjorie Zander. All right. We won't leave you out.

ctx.x: I just want to get down where we're doing this. We're doing it at your home at 700 Thales Street. That's in Algiers. And what's your name? Charles E. Love. And my name is Dick Allen. And you got a name? Marjorie Zander. All right. We won't leave you out. I'm always scared I'm going to leave me out. You know I forget that half the time. To leave my name and I want the secretary to know what it's all about when she hears it. You were going to sing a song for us?
Well I can sing the chorus of that hoodoo song. I'll sing the chorus of it. I don't know
